name: SH2 Cast - Right Staff (aimed)
description: MSCO's Base - Right Staff art (its MSCO_right1-4 staff set) on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget AIMED cast resolved to the RIGHT hand while a staff is held in that hand. MSCO's own Right Staff submod sits on the MSCO_right* paths, which the Driver Cast states never ask for, so before this cell a right-staff hotbar cast played the plain right set. Each clip carries MSCO's MRh_SpellFire_Event (0.400000 / 0.333333 / 0.400000 / 0.366667), the armed hand's commitment point for this cell.
